notes.title: The 1.0 version is out now!
notes.notes: This is a great day to me as a solo gamedev, my first 1.0 game is gonna be released, with every monster with better animation, with more stores, and all that I want on my first version of this game, of course on future updates the game will change, I hope that I can make it better and better with time, hope you guys like it =)

notes.title: Launching!
notes.notes:
At last the game is going out for public at march 16! Get your coins, trow at your screen and get the game for only 9,99USD, with 15% of discount at the launch!
Still on early, but with the comunity help, this game will be a lot bigger and a lot better! 
The idea is to set the 1.0 on october, so we can put all the 10 monsters, and some extras. We redrawing some monsters, and redoing some stores, so the game will get better with small patches.
Thanks for everyone that already wishlist it, and all my friends that support me.

Green Cube Games.
